description.value: Tama Organic Life is a small, family-run organic produce store that has operated in East Vancouver since the mid-1990s, built around sourcing locally grown seasonal fruits, vegetables, and Japanese specialty produce (daikon, burdock root, komatsuna) directly from BC farms. The store also carries a curated Japanese pantry including fermented foods, dried goods, and specialty ingredients. A touring cyclist would find it a practical resupply stop for fresh organic produce and daily-made vegan bento boxes prepared to order.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, family-run organic produce store at #102-2828 East Hastings Street, Vancouver (matching OSM address and phone). The site references fresh produce, dried goods, and Japanese pantry items as core stock, and explicitly promotes daily-made vegan bento boxes as a prepared food offering. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM 'community' field lists 'North Vancouver' but the store address (#102-2828 East Hastings Street) is in East Vancouver, City of Vancouver — not North Vancouver. The store's own website describes it as 'located in East Vancouver'. The community tag should be corrected.
Website states founding year as both '1996' (header tagline) and '1995' (body text) — minor internal inconsistency, not a directory concern.

OSM opening hours (We-Sa 09:30-18:00; Su-Tu 09:30-16:00) differ from the hours shown on the website contact page — per rules, hours are excluded from fields, but the discrepancy may indicate OSM tags are outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active neighbourhood organic grocery with fresh produce, prepared vegan bento meals, and a wide Japanese pantry — a genuinely useful resupply stop for touring cyclists on East Hastings. Business is confirmed open and operational.

Hot food.detail: Website prominently features 'Tama's Bento – made daily, made to order – using all organic ingredients'; described as vegan bento-style lunch boxes with a weekly changing menu

wow_evidence: family-run organic produce store... daily-made vegan bento boxes prepared to order
